SchurWeyl.Hecke ℂ (Complex.exp (2 * κ * (↑Real.pi * Complex.I))) (Complex.exp (2 * κ * (↑Real.pi * Complex.I)))⁻¹ 1 →ₐ[ℂ] A

theorem QOU.Mass.KZTwoStrandHecke.kzTwoStrand_isHeckeQuad {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2) →* A) (κ c : ℂ) [CompleteSpace A] :
BraidHeckeFactor.IsHeckeQuad (Complex.exp (2 * κ * (↑Real.pi * Complex.I) * c)) (Complex.exp (2 * κ * (↑Real.pi * Complex.I))) (Complex.exp (2 * κ * (↑Real.pi * Complex.I)))⁻¹ ↑((KZHolonomy.kzBraidRep ρ κ c) (MathlibExt.Braid.σ 0))

theorem QOU.Mass.KZTwoStrandHecke.kzBraidRep_two_σ {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2) →* A) (κ c : ℂ) [CompleteSpace A] :
↑((KZHolonomy.kzBraidRep ρ κ c) (MathlibExt.Braid.σ 0)) = Complex.exp (2 * κ * (↑Real.pi * Complex.I) * (1 - c)) • eP (ρ (KZHolonomy.adjSwap 0)) - Complex.exp (-(2 * κ * (↑Real.pi * Complex.I) * (1 + c))) • eM (ρ (KZHolonomy.adjSwap 0))

theorem QOU.Mass.KZTwoStrandHecke.genFund_two_one {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2) →* A) (κ c : ℂ) [CompleteSpace A] :
KZHolonomy.genFund ρ κ c 0 1 = Usol (ρ (KZHolonomy.adjSwap 0)) (2 * κ * (↑Real.pi * Complex.I)) c 1

theorem QOU.Mass.KZTwoStrandHecke.rho_adjSwap_sq {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2) →* A) :
ρ (KZHolonomy.adjSwap 0) * ρ (KZHolonomy.adjSwap 0) = 1

theorem QOU.Mass.KZTwoStrandHecke.kzForm_genPath_two {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] (ρ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2) →* A) (κ c : ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
(KZHolonomy.kzForm ρ κ c (KZHolonomy.genPath 0 t)) (KZHolonomy.genPath' 0 t) = (2 * κ * (↑Real.pi * Complex.I)) • (ρ (KZHolonomy.adjSwap 0) - (algebraMap ℂ A) c)

theorem QOU.Mass.KZTwoStrandHecke.dlog_two (t : ℝ) :
(-(KZHolonomy.eArc' t / 2) - KZHolonomy.eArc' t / 2) / (↑0 + 1 / 2 - KZHolonomy.eArc t / 2 - (↑0 + 1 / 2 + KZHolonomy.eArc t / 2)) = ↑Real.pi * Complex.I

theorem QOU.Mass.KZTwoStrandHecke.eArc_ne_zero (t : ℝ) :
KZHolonomy.eArc t ≠ 0

theorem QOU.Mass.KZTwoStrandHecke.eArc'_eq (t : ℝ) :
KZHolonomy.eArc' t = ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * KZHolonomy.eArc t

KZHolonomy.IsFundSol (fun (x : ℝ) => θ • (P - (algebraMap ℂ A) c)) (Usol P θ c)

theorem QOU.Mass.KZTwoStrandHecke.resid_mul_eM {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] {P : A} (hP : P * P = 1) (θ c : ℂ) :
θ • (P - (algebraMap ℂ A) c) * eM P = -(θ * (1 + c)) • eM P

theorem QOU.Mass.KZTwoStrandHecke.resid_mul_eP {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] {P : A} (hP : P * P = 1) (θ c : ℂ) :
θ • (P - (algebraMap ℂ A) c) * eP P = (θ * (1 - c)) • eP P

theorem QOU.Mass.KZTwoStrandHecke.split_hecke {A : Type u_1} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] {P : A} (hP : P * P = 1) {q : ℂ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
(q • eP P - q⁻¹ • eM P) * (q • eP P - q⁻¹ • eM P) = (q - q⁻¹) • (q • eP P - q⁻¹ • eM P) + (q * q⁻¹) • 1
